summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of its July 27, 2026 Board of Directors meeting. The Board acknowledged committee reports, reviewed Q2 2026 financials under limited review by Ernst & Young, approved capital increases of up to R$600 million in I-Systems Soluções de Infraestrutura S.A. and up to R$70 million in V8 Consulting S.A., and noted a corporate governance report. These are routine operational and governance matters. No special situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, going-private transaction, restructuring, or significant management change is disclosed. The subsidiary capitalizations are ordinary internal funding decisions, not transformative corporate actions.
